seg.seg_note: Three segments from Q3 FY2017: Communication Systems, Electronic Systems, Space and Intelligence Systems. Critical Networks was eliminated: CapRock (sold 1-Jan-2017) and government IT Services (sold 28-Apr-2017) are discontinued operations and the remaining businesses (air traffic management, PMRF) moved into Electronic Systems; stranded costs and FAS pension income of the former segment were re-allocated to the three segments. Unallocated corporate expense (223) includes 109 of Exelis intangible amortization and 58 of Exelis acquisition-related and other charges (10-K). Segment funded backlog from the 10-K ($ billions: CS 1.1, ES 1.9, SIS 1.1).

ngaap.guidance: FY2018 (initial): income from continuing operations $5.85 - $6.05 per diluted share; revenue $6.02 - 6.14 billion (up 2 - 4 percent); adjusted net cash provided by operating activities $980 to $1,030 million, net capital expenditures about $130 million, free cash flow $850 - 900 million.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP income from continuing operations / EPS excludes Exelis acquisition-related and other items, shown only net of tax in the FY2017 release (51 after-tax, $0.41 per share). The pre-tax amount of 58 is from the FY2017 10-K segment note and the FY2018 release (operating income adjustment (B) 58; per-share 0.46 pre-tax, tax (0.05)); the implied tax effect of about (7) is a difference, not a published figure. Amortization of Exelis intangibles is NOT excluded. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow + $400m voluntary pension contribution - net capital expenditures; unadjusted free cash flow is not published. Adjusted FCF = 133% of GAAP and 123% of non-GAAP income from continuing operations.

notes: is.lines_raw = 10-K statement of income (first column) followed by the earnings-release condensed statement lines (prefixed "[Q4 release ...]"), which add dividends per share and weighted average shares; mapped keys use the 10-K. is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). cf.da = Depreciation and amortization 183 + Amortization of intangible assets from Exelis Inc. acquisition 128 (cash flow covers continuing and discontinued operations; the segment note gives 109 for continuing operations). The FY2018 release re-presents FY2017 cost of sales as 3,734 and ESA as 1,093 (vs 3,811 / 1,016 here) with operating income unchanged at 1,073. Self-checks: all pass.
